analysis: MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW (2026-07-08): SPY remains in uptrend (+1.4% vs SMA50, slope +3.64%), a constructive backdrop. However, the portfolio is essentially at capacity — 89% deployed across 5 positions with only $6,358 headroom before hitting the 95% gross cap. Trying to add a 6th position with $6,358 would create a trivially small ~0.6% allocation with negligible impact while adding complexity. The honest answer is: no room to add. EXISTING POSITIONS: AMP is the standout winner at +12.93% — thesis intact, no action needed. FDS has moved into 'uptrend extending' territory per the screener (+11.6% vs SMA50 with a wide 4.9% ATR), so it bears watching — if it fades back below its SMA50 or fails to hold recent highs, that would be a thesis-softening signal worth acting on, but no break yet at +5.07% gain. A, CI, and LII are all small gainers with intact trends; no thesis breaks identified. HISTORICAL PERFORMANCE FLAG: Win rate of 14.3% with Sortino of -3.36 is a clear warning that forcing trades has destroyed value in this account. Every recent loss was a stop-hit after a premature entry. The disciplined response is to stay patient. CANDIDATE SCREENING: MU shows extraordinary metrics but is +107% vs SMA200 with 11.1% ATR — far too extended and volatile. VEEV, WDAY, and SYF are the highest-quality setups fundamentally (low PEG, strong FCF), but with only $6,358 deployable, any position would be too small to size properly per risk rules (1-2% equity at risk requires ~$1,500-$2,000 risk capacity, which at standard ATR multiples implies positions of $20k+). CONCLUSION: Holding all 5 current positions. No new buys — capital is nearly fully deployed, historical entry discipline has been poor, and cash protection IS the alpha. The next opportunity will arise when an existing position stops out or hits target, freeing capital for a properly sized entry.
